description.value: By consuming 1 pint of blood from a spellcaster killed within the last 24 hours, you can attempt to learn a spell that spellcaster knew. Select one spell available to the dead spellcaster (this must be a spell on your class’s spell list); you gain the knowledge of this spell for 24 hours. During this time, you may write it down using the normal rules for scribe scroll . Once you have learned it, you may cast the spell normally.
